text:
Fiona MacLeod  
Email: fionamacleod@email.com | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/fionamacleod | GitHub: github.com/fionamacleod | Location: Bengaluru, India  

A recent graduate in Electrical Engineering with hands-on experience in embedded systems, currently consulting on firmware development and IoT integration projects. My work focuses on bridging hardware and software through real-time systems, sensor networks, and protocol implementation. I bring a practical mindset to problem-solving, driven by the goal of creating reliable, scalable solutions for emerging tech challenges.  

Technical Skills  
Core competencies include firmware development for microcontroller-based systems, IoT protocol implementation (MQTT, CoAP), and real-time operating system (RTOS) integration. Experience with sensor integration in industrial and consumer applications, including data acquisition and edge processing. Familiar with basic network troubleshooting techniques to ensure system connectivity. Limited exposure to Python for scripting and automation tasks.  

Professional Experience  
At NexaTech Solutions, I collaborate on embedded projects for clients in smart agriculture and healthcare. Recently, I contributed to a firmware update for a wireless sensor network, improving data transmission reliability by 15% through optimized MQTT payload structures. This involved debugging communication latency issues and aligning with client requirements for low-power operation.  

Previously, I interned at TechNova Systems, where I supported the development of a medical device’s embedded interface. My role included integrating temperature and humidity sensors with a custom RTOS, ensuring real-time data sampling and fault tolerance. This project required close coordination with hardware engineers to synchronize peripheral drivers and validate system performance under varying load conditions.  

During a part-time role at InnovateHub, I assisted in prototyping an IoT-enabled irrigation system. The project involved designing a modular architecture using CoAP for device communication and implementing firmware for soil moisture sensors. I also documented the system’s power management strategies, which reduced energy consumption by 20% in field tests.  

Education  
Bachelor of Electrical Engineering, University of British Columbia, Canada (2023). Thesis: “Optimizing Sensor Fusion in Low-Cost IoT Devices,” focusing on algorithms for combining data from multiple environmental sensors to enhance accuracy in resource-constrained environments.  

Projects  
Developed a firmware module for a smart irrigation controller, enabling dynamic water distribution based on real-time soil data. The project utilized an RTOS to manage concurrent tasks and ensure timely response to sensor inputs.  
Designed an IoT framework for a wearable health monitor, integrating MQTT for secure data transmission and implementing a lightweight protocol stack for edge processing.  
Contributed to a university research project on energy-efficient sensor networks, where I evaluated the trade-offs between CoAP and HTTP for low-bandwidth environments. The findings were presented at a regional engineering conference.  

Languages  
English (fluent), Hindi (basic).  

Awards & Achievements  
Recipient of the UBC Engineering Innovation Award (2023) for a project on adaptive sensor calibration. Recognized at TechNova Systems for contributing to a successful product launch in Q4 2023.
